signature: SUBROUTINE DLAED2( K, N, N1, D, Q, LDQ, INDXQ, RHO, Z, DLAMBDA, W,

params.name: k
params.reference: The number of non-deflated eigenvalues, and the order of the related secular equation. $0 \le K \le N$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The dimension of the symmetric tridiagonal matrix. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: n1
params.reference: The location of the last eigenvalue in the leading sub-matrix. $\min (1,N) \le N_{1} \le N/2$.

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry, D contains the eigenvalues of the two submatrices to be combined. On exit, D contains the trailing (N-K) updated eigenvalues (those which were deflated) sorted into increasing order.

params.name: Q
params.reference: On entry, Q contains the eigenvectors of two submatrices in the two square blocks with corners at (1,1), (`N1`,`N1`) and (`N1`+1, `N1`+1), (N,N). On exit, Q contains the trailing (N-K) updated eigenvectors (those which were deflated) in its last N-K columns.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: INDXQ
params.reference: The permutation which separately sorts the two sub-problems in D into ascending order. Note that elements in the second half of this permutation must first have `N1` added to their values. Destroyed on exit.

params.name: rho
params.reference: On entry, the off-diagonal element associated with the rank-1 cut which originally split the two submatrices which are now being recombined. On exit, `RHO` has been modified to the value required by DLAED3.

params.name: z
params.reference: On entry, Z contains the updating vector (the last row of the first sub-eigenvector matrix and the first row of the second sub-eigenvector matrix). On exit, the contents of Z have been destroyed by the updating process.

params.name: DLAMBDA
params.reference: A copy of the first K eigenvalues which will be used by DLAED3 to form the secular equation.

params.name: w
params.reference: The first k values of the final deflation-altered z-vector which will be passed to DLAED3.

params.name: Q2
params.reference: A copy of the first K eigenvectors which will be used by DLAED3 in a matrix multiply (DGEMM) to solve for the new eigenvectors.

params.name: INDX
params.reference: The permutation used to sort the contents of `DLAMBDA` into ascending order.

params.name: INDXC
params.reference: The permutation used to arrange the columns of the deflated Q matrix into three groups: the first group contains non-zero elements only at and above `N1`, the second contains non-zero elements only below `N1`, and the third is dense.

params.name: INDXP
params.reference: The permutation used to place deflated values of D at the end of the array. `INDXP(1:K)` points to the nondeflated D-values and `INDXP(K+1:N)` points to the deflated eigenvalues.

params.name: COLTYP
params.reference: During execution, a label which will indicate which of the following types a column in the `Q2` matrix is: 1 : non-zero in the upper half only; 2 : dense; 3 : non-zero in the lower half only; 4 : deflated. On exit, `COLTYP(i)` is the number of columns of type i, for $i=1$ to 4 only.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.

checks.js: min( 1, trunc( N / 2 ) ) > n1 || trunc( N / 2 ) < n1

overrides.reason: Q2 is documented as N1**2+(N-N1)**2, but dlaed2.f writes past that: the full-deflation path copies N*N entries into Q2 (lines 323-330) and each deflated column writes N entries (line 510). DLAED1's 4N+N**2 WORK, which follows Q2, absorbs the overrun. The JS wrapper must size Q2 by what the code touches, N*N (ticket 0068).
